name: skogai-core
description: Acts upon Claude Code hook events with one script per event. Each part (event log, turn journal, diff state files, git steps, status line) is a mod setting, all off by default.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Off: no log, journal, state files, git steps or status line, whatever else is set.

events.title: Events to log
events.description: Space-separated hook event names to log; globs work, such as Post*. * logs every event. The journal needs UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse*.

log_path.title: Log path
log_path.description: Event log file (JSON lines), relative to the git root or absolute.

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: On Stop, append the turn (prompt, reply, tool uses) to the journal and commit only that file.

journal_path.title: Journal path
journal_path.description: Turn journal file, relative to the git root or absolute.

write_state.title: Write state files
write_state.description: On SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop, write git-diff, git-diff-cached and wt-step-diff to the state directory.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where the state files go, relative to the git root or absolute.

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Show hook: <event> from the log's last row.

stage_on_stop.title: Stage on Stop
stage_on_stop.description: git add -A when a turn ends.

commit_on_stop.title: Commit on Stop
commit_on_stop.description: wt step commit when a turn ends.

merge_on_stop.title: Merge on Stop
merge_on_stop.description: wt merge --no-remove when a turn ends.

stage_on_prompt.title: Stage on prompt
stage_on_prompt.description: git add -A when a prompt is submitted.

commit_on_prompt.title: Commit on prompt
commit_on_prompt.description: wt step commit when a prompt is submitted.

merge_on_prompt.title: Merge on prompt
merge_on_prompt.description: wt merge --no-remove when a prompt is submitted.
